title: Graduated shadowing runbook and forensic audit export for RBAC v2 migration
creator: Nadia Chen
description: Goal: Implement a graduated shadowing strategy for RBAC v2 that lets small cohorts of accounts opt into dual-write + shadow enforcement, collect deterministic audit logs and offline forensic exports, validate SSO/SAML mappings, and provide emergency admin shields and rollback hooks for safe cutover. Scope includes: 1) a runbook for graduated opt-in waves (account-level toggles), 2) a dual-write verifier that flags divergence with remediation suggestions, 3) an offline forensic audit export pipeline (signed, tamper-evident), and 4) admin emergency controls (temporary admin shield, role rollback endpoint). This ticket coordinates engineering work, security sign-off, and customer communications templates.
acceptance_criteria: Shadowing toggle per-customer implemented and available in admin console
Dual-write verifier runs continuously and surfaces divergence metrics to the RBAC dashboard
Forensic audit export can generate a signed export (JSONL) for any account with at least 30 days of history and verify integrity locally
SSO/SAML mapping validation job shows >= 99.5% deterministic mapping for first 3 canary customers
Emergency admin shield toggles revert effective permissions to RBAC v1 rules within 60s and are audited
Runbook steps documented and rehearsed with on-call and customer success (dry-run completed)
rollout_plan: Wave 0: internal platform teams (10 internal orgs) enable shadowing; monitor divergence for 72h
Wave 1: invited beta customers (5 customer orgs) opt-in via support opt-in flow; collect feedback 1 week
Wave 2: graduated batch rollouts by usage tier; automated gating on divergence and error budget
Wave 3: broad migration window scheduled after 4 successful waves and security sign-off
rollback_plan: 1) If divergence spikes > 0.5% for 3 consecutive hours, enable admin shield for affected orgs
2) Toggle customer shadowing off (immediate stop of RBAC v2 enforcement) and fail back to RBAC v1 for in-flight requests
3) Run reconciliation backfill and replay signed audit exports to identify missing state
4) Notify customers and CS with predefined template and post-mortem within 48h
monitoring_signals: Authorization latency P95 when in shadow vs control path
Audit export generation time and verification success rate
Admin shield toggles count and mean time to revert

notes: Trade-offs: we accept small read-after-write divergence during shadowing rather than global strong consistency to reduce rollout risk and avoid large migration window. For customers requiring immediate consistency we will offer a flagged fast-path migration with additional cost and stricter canaries. Follow-up tickets will cover ephemeral-role backfills and SSO edge-case reconcilers.
